fixed_on: 2026-09-30, before the first protocol run; decisions D9-D11 applied the same day

protocol.laplace_number_definition: La = rho*gamma*lambda/mu^2 (Popinet 2009, section 5.3); Oh = 1/sqrt(La) = 0.0183, epsilon = nu*k^2/omega0 = 0.0458
protocol.time_step: One time step shared by all levels (decision D10): the largest dt within the one-sided capillary limit of the finest level, sqrt(rho*h^3/(4*pi*gamma)) with h = lambda/64 (= (1/sqrt(2)) * sqrt(rho*h^3/(2*pi*gamma))), that divides the run into 100 equal output intervals: dt = 5.50e-4, 2900 steps. The spatial study at 16/32/64 therefore carries no level-dependent time error.
protocol.reference: Prosperetti initial-value solution for a free surface (Phys. Fluids 19, 195 (1976); Phys. Fluids 24, 1217 (1981), one-fluid limit), fitted with the same damped-cosine model on the same output times as the simulation
protocol.note: Criteria apply separately to each (capillary form, transport, Laplace number) spatial study at the shared protocol time step (dt divisor 1). See README.md for the definitions and the cost of each level.
protocol.time_step_study: Separate, at lambda/h = 32: dt, dt/2, dt/4 (generate_case.py --dt-divisor 1, 2, 4); reported only (D10)
protocol.transport: Level-set advection with the PDE velocity extension of decision D9 once it is in the solver (generate_case.py --transport pde_extension); until then wet_extension (wall_compatible_normal), the D9 comparison baseline. Criteria apply per (capillary form, transport) study.

criteria.definition: |omega_sim - omega_ref| / omega_ref. omega_sim is the angular frequency of the least-squares fit exp(-beta t)(c1 cos(omega t) + c2 sin(omega t)) to the cos(kx) mode amplitude a_h(t) over all outputs including t = 0; omega_ref is the same fit to Prosperetti's a(t) sampled at the same times.
criteria.order_method: least-squares slope of log(error) against log(lambda/h) over order_levels, on the spatial study at the shared time step (D10); pairwise orders are reported
criteria.source: Decision D1 working criterion (tracker section 5, M3: frequency error <= 2% at lambda/h = 32, with convergence over 16/32/64). First order is the rate expected for the force on a piecewise-planar interface (Gross and Reusken 2011, ch. 7), as for the static-drop pressure jump.

criteria.definition: |beta_sim - beta_ref| / beta_ref with beta the amplitude decay rate of the same two fits.
criteria.order_method: least-squares slope of log(error) against log(lambda/h) over order_levels, on the spatial study at the shared time step (D10); pairwise orders are reported
criteria.source: Decision D1 working criterion (tracker section 5, M3: damping error <= 5% at lambda/h = 32, with convergence over 16/32/64), also applied at the finest level (lambda/h = 64) as in decision D12.

criteria.definition: max over the whole run of |A(t) - A(0)| / A(0) (decision D11): over all VTU outputs and, when solver_run.log[.gz] is present, over the per-step 'Wet volume diagnostic' areas of every accepted step. A is the exact area of {phi_h < 0}; A(0) that of the sampled initial level set in mesh/mesh-complete.mesh.vtu
criteria.source: Decision D1 working criterion (tracker section 5: volume drift <= 1e-4, as for M1 and M2, applied to M3), gated on the maximum deviation over the run (decision D11). A(0) includes the whole liquid layer (depth ~ lambda); mean_level_drift_over_amplitude reports the same drift relative to a0.
